quest.title: A Defensive Strategy
quest.description: Having successfully ventured into the Ley Line disturbance's hidden Domain and emerged victorious from its trials, it's time to report back to Keqing and Yelan...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew, this domain is messed up — no wonder even Yelan found it dicey...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Which major historical battle do you think is being re-enacted here? Feels like one where most soldiers would be way out of their depth...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yikes, hopefully not! ...Surely not, right? Please tell Paimon you're exaggerating!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: And... by the look on your face, I'm guessing this is a triumphant return after all?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure is! But it was really, really scary in there!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You describe the battles you fought to Keqing and Yelan...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Incredible... You did very well to brave all of that and still emerge victorious. Good work!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: After you entered the domain, there was a sharp drop in stray monsters out here.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: And although you didn't eliminate the root of the problem, it's plain to see you've weakened the Ley Line disturbance considerably.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Which means you've weakened the monsters as well. Now, any rank-and-file soldiers can comfortably fend them off.

choices.text: Or... they could enter the domain and get a taste of real danger.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Why do you sound weirdly excited about this, {NICKNAME}? Don't go getting too bloodthirsty!

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: #Oh, one other thing. We received a response from Yujing Terrace. Both the Tianquan and the Kaiyang have agreed to establish a long-term partnership with {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Thanks to your tireless efforts, we may even be able to turn this Ley Line disturbance to our advantage.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Moving forward, you'll have the full support of this garrison.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: While the disturbance remains active, the Millelith will take care of any monsters that escape from the domain, using the opportunity to hone their combat skills. You, of course, are free to enter the domain if you so wish.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: We've turned the tables on this situation. What started as a potential crisis is now a major asset to Millelith recruits.

choices.text: Great news. I'll keep giving it my all!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahh... That's a big weight off our shoulders...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh yeah — Ley Lines are pretty fascinating things, aren't they? If only there was a way to grab them and shake all the secrets out...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Or who knows, maybe one day we'll run into some smart cookie who hands us a big, thick book called "Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Ley Lines"!

choices.text: With the immediate danger gone, I'll support as needed!
The Ley Line disturbance is a stubborn foe. It will take time to conquer it.
